# Sam Mozaffari

> Experience Designer in Sydney, Australia. Research, service blueprints, stakeholder workshops and practical AI for operational services. Australian citizen; Sydney hybrid or remote within Australia; permanent, contract and consulting work considered.

## Who

- Experience Designer at KFC South Pacific, July 2024 to present. Leads and co-leads service-improvement projects across safety reporting, workforce-management tools, hiring and onboarding, learning platforms and employee experience.
- Conducts interviews and user testing, creates service blueprints, facilitates stakeholder workshops, prioritises improvements with evidence. Project and stakeholder leadership; does not manage a team of designers.
- Uses AI daily in research synthesis and built an internal tool that extracts and classifies interview insights with AI, each record reviewed by hand. Building evidence for designing AI-enabled services; has not shipped an AI feature to production users.
- Earlier: product designer in electrical hardware and digital products (2021 to 2024); UX designer on public-sector forms (part-time, 2020 to 2023); product designer in retail environments (2019 to 2021).

## Work (employment, one employer, organisation and vendors anonymised)

- [Safety incident reporting](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/articles/57/index.html): research to a five-stage blueprint to three proposals, held in an insight tool he built. Led research and design. Proposals and prototypes delivered; adoption unconfirmed.
- [Workforce platform prioritisation](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/articles/52/index.html): a four-lane blueprint and a scored top ten for a vendor conversation. Co-led with one other designer.
- [Hiring and onboarding](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/articles/55/index.html): nine-stage blueprint and an automated screening-to-interview path. Led the design work; outcome figures under review.
- [Learning platform replacement](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/articles/56/index.html): business case, scoping workshop, compliance-gated journey and pilot. Led the design work; rollout figures under review.
- Further write-ups, figures under review: [employee experience](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/articles/50/index.html), [service quality](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/articles/51/index.html), [self-service channel](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/articles/53/index.html), [drive-thru](https://sammozaffari.github.io/the-agentic-service-designer-site/articles/54/index.html).
